title: Model Action Plan for Responding to Significant Data Breaches
summary: The Model Action Plan is a cross-government framework for all departments to follow when responding to significant personal data breaches.

title: Charities and Community Amateur Sports Clubs: enquiries
summary: Contact HMRC if your Charity or Community Amateur Sports Club needs help on Gift Aid, Payroll Giving, tax reliefs, VAT or completing a Company or Self Assessment tax return.

title: VAT: general enquiries
summary: Contact HMRC to report changes to your business or ask questions about VAT (including Making Tax Digital for VAT) and Fulfilment House Due Diligence Scheme (FHDDS).

title: VAT: reliefs for disabled and older people enquiries
summary: Contact HMRC for information about VAT reliefs available for disabled and older people.

title: Known supply problems with animal medicines
summary: Reported problems with the supply of an animal medicine and the date when the issue is expected to be resolved.

title: Support for students travelling to the UK from Gaza
summary: How the government is helping students travelling to the UK from Gaza to take up a scholarship.

title: The marginal cost restriction on public sector data re-use: call for evidence
summary: This call for evidence asks for views on if public bodies should charge above marginal costs for the re-use of public sector data, and what approaches and conditions should apply.

title: Data flows you can trust
summary: This call for evidence asks for practical, experience-based insight into whether the UK’s data regime is enabling data flows you can trust.

title: Data regulation in the age of AI and other data‑intensive technologies
summary: This call for evidence asks for examples of how data regulation interacts with AI and data-intensive technologies, and how technological progress may change data use in the economy.

title: Perceptions of temporary use bans (hosepipe bans) in England
summary: Research on public perceptions and attitudes towards temporary use bans (TUBs), also known as hosepipe bans, during droughts and periods of hot weather.
